Evidence before promises

Ask for documents, real project references, named responsibility and written scope. ProPulse directly undertakes construction and interior execution in Hyderabad and also helps customers discover independent businesses through its marketplace. Check the named contracting entity and responsibilities in the quotation and agreement before paying.

Six checks before hiring an interior company

1. Check completed interiors and execution capability

Review comparable homes and actual completed work. A 3D render shows intent; inspect installed finishes, alignment, drawer movement and who manages each trade.

  • Multiple completed projects
  • Permitted site visit and owner reference
  • Clear split between in-house and subcontracted work

2. Finalise a room-wise scope

Define dimensions, storage, appliances, finishes and exclusions before comparing package prices.

  • Kitchen, wardrobes, lofts and storage
  • TV, shoe, crockery and study units
  • Ceiling, lights, electrical changes and painting

3. Verify boards, plywood and finishes

Ask for exact board type, grade, thickness, manufacturer and intended use. Select materials for the exposure and load; protect edges in moisture-prone zones.

  • Board grade and thickness by application
  • Laminate, acrylic, veneer or paint finish
  • Edge-band thickness and finish quality
  • Written approval for substitutions

4. Compare hinges, channels and accessories

Identify hardware by brand or approved equivalent, product series, extension, load rating where relevant, soft-close function and warranty.

  • Hinge type and soft-close function
  • Drawer channel extension and load rating
  • Lift-up systems, baskets and pull-outs

5. Check drawings and service coordination

Approve measured layouts and elevations. Coordinate appliance dimensions, electrical points, plumbing, ventilation, ceiling and access panels before production.

  • Room-wise plans and elevations
  • Appliance schedule
  • Electrical, lighting and plumbing drawings
  • Final site measurement and signed revision

6. Review BOQ, timeline, payments and warranty

Document unit-wise quantities, material codes, installation stages, payment milestones, delivery, snag rectification and after-sales support.

  • Transport, installation and taxes
  • Milestone payments and change orders
  • Warranty duration, exclusions and service process

Compare quotations fairly

Share the same room list, measured dimensions, finish schedule, hardware expectations and appliance details. Compare exclusions and taxes as carefully as the headline price. There is no universal ranking that proves one company is best for every homeowner.

Frequently asked questions

How do I choose the best interior designers in Hyderabad?

Compare completed projects, drawings, room-wise BOQs, material and hardware specifications, installation quality, timelines and written warranty terms.

How much do 2BHK interiors cost in Hyderabad?

Cost depends on rooms, dimensions, storage, board and finish choices, hardware, ceiling, electrical work, appliances and installation. Request a dated, itemised quote.

Which plywood is best for home interiors?

There is no single board for every location. Select a documented grade suitable for exposure, load and application.

What should an interior design agreement include?

Rooms, drawings, dimensions, material codes, hardware, inclusions, exclusions, taxes, installation, timeline, milestones, warranty and snag rectification.
